what_this_is: The set of 04-AUDITS/validate-registers.py failures present in the tree when the push gate was changed from absolute to baseline. .claude/hooks/block-push-on-register-failure.sh blocks a push only for a failure that is NOT in this set. Every entry below is a failure the repository is currently carrying knowingly, with the reason it is being carried. This file excuses failures; it does not fix them, and nothing here is a finding.
how_a_failure_is_matched: By the three-part key file -> row_id -> failure_type, plus an exact match on `detail`. row_id is the register's own identifier column, so a row keeps its excuse when other rows are inserted above it and line numbers move. `detail` is the specific offending value. A baselined key whose detail has changed is reported as a NEW failure and blocks, on the reasoning that a cell that has been edited since it was excused has not been looked at by the owner in its current form. That is deliberately the strict side of the line: it can block a push for an edit that is in fact harmless, and the remedy is to re-record the baseline and say so in the pull request.
how_to_re_record: This file is written by hand, not generated on demand — regenerating it automatically before a push would make the gate self-excusing and worth nothing. To add an entry, run `python3 04-AUDITS/validate-registers.py --json`, take the failure's file / row_id / failure_type / detail, and write a why_excused that an owner could disagree with.
owner_can_disagree_with_any_of_this: Deleting an entry restores the absolute gate for that row. Deleting the whole `entries` object restores it for the tree.

status-not-in-vocabulary.detail: VERIFIED as a measurement; not a claim about origins
status-not-in-vocabulary.why_excused: VALIDATOR-FINDINGS-2026-09-07.md reserves this row for the owner. The status cell carries a load-bearing qualification ('VERIFIED as a measurement; not a claim about origins') that keeps the 253-lemma residue from ever being cited as a count of borrowings — the constitution §4.E 'unknown is residual' guard. The qualification belongs in `reason`, not in `status`, but moving it is a change to a guard and is the owner's to make. Excused so the guard is not quietly loosened by a session that only wanted to push.
